name: Countdown leader marks a build-in-progress beat
looks: A giant blocky time readout sits over a deep red brick texture, a thin build-log line above it reading like a terminal status. A short ruled progress line underneath, with a small marker on it, places the card in a longer sequence of similar example categories.
build: Numeral set in a heavy slab face filling most of the card over a tiled brick texture at full saturation; it ticks on whole-second hard cuts, no easing. The progress rule's marker sits at this card's position relative to the full sequence.
sound: A mechanical tick on each coarse time step, a low ambient rumble under the hold.
prompt: Mark a build-in-progress beat with a giant blocky timer numeral over a rough brick or concrete texture, a short build-log status line above it, ticking in hard coarse steps rather than smooth animation, so the moment feels physical and workmanlike.
